From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearside.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearside.com
Date: Sun, 7 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/SOC2: KMS rotation + telemetry evidence request

Hi Priyom,

We're running a SIG baseline for Clearside and our auditor has asked for a compact package of KMS/HSM evidence focused on rotation and telemetry. Can you please provide the following items (redacted for PII where necessary):

- Rotation runbook (procedures for KEK/DEK rotation, frequency, verification steps)
- Sample rotation events with timestamps and operator IDs for the last 6 months
- HSM operator shiftlogs (anonymized) and separation-of-duties matrix
- Access control matrix showing roles that can perform key rotations and wrap/unwrap operations
- Network-in-transit encryption posture and TLS cipher inventory for KMS endpoints

We'd like to receive an initial package by EOD Tue 2029-04-09; if that window is not possible, let me know an alternative. If you need to coordinate redaction or sign an NDA for operator names, we can accommodate.

Thanks — appreciate a single delivery (zip or shared folder) with a short manifest indicating what is in each file.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Security Assurance, Clearside
liam.oconnor@clearside.com

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearside.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 7 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/SOC2: KMS rotation + telemetry evidence request

Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a compact bundle that covers each item you listed. Plan below:

1) What we'll deliver by Tue 2029-04-09 (EOD PDT):
   - kms-rotation-runbook.pdf (redacted where necessary)
   - operator-access-matrix.csv (roles + approved ops; personal identifiers redacted; operator IDs salted)
   - hsm-shiftlog-sample.txt (3 shift snapshots, anonymized)
   - rotation-events-6mo.csv (UTC timestamps, key-id, event-type, operator-id-hash)
   - tls-cipher-inventory.txt (KMS endpoint TLS configs and cipher suites)

2) Delivery method: single S3 folder (read-only) + Drive manifest. Link will be provided and we can optionally provision a time-limited signed URL.

3) Redactions and concerns: We will salt/hash operator usernames and provide a mapping key under an NDA if Clearside requires identifiable operator names. Let us know if you need that.

4) Point of contact for technical questions: jonas.weber@redwood.ai (security/compliance), for scheduling/contract questions: ben.carter@redwood.ai. Hannah will handle SOC 2 framing notes and the manifest.

I'll start pulling the artifacts now and will follow up with a notification when upload completes.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Liam —

Attached is the compact evidence bundle we discussed. Contents and delivery notes below; everything is in the shared folder and the S3 prefix (links at bottom). Files that contained sensitive operator identifiers have been salted and hashed; a signed NDA will be required for unredacted mappings.

Delivered artifacts (zip: clearside_kmsevidence_20290409.zip):
- kms-rotation-runbook.pdf — Operational steps for KEK/DEK rotation, verification checks, automated test hooks.
- rotation-events-6mo.csv — 6 months of rotation events (UTC timestamps, key_id, event_type, operator_id_hash).
- hsm-shiftlog-sample.txt — three anonymized shiftlog snapshots with event context.
- operator-access-matrix.csv — role -> allowed key operations (rotate, wrap/unwrap, revoke).
- tls-cipher-inventory.txt — current TLS config for KMS endpoints and allowed cipher suites.
- soc2-framing-note.txt — mapping to SOC 2 CC6.* criteria and notes on redaction approach (author: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai).

Notes / caveats:
- Operator identifiers are hashed with per-tenant salt to preserve correlation while protecting PII. If Clearside requires true operator names for an incident investigation we can exchange a sealed mapping under NDA.
- The HSM shiftlogs included have been inspected for sensitive customer data; none was found and no secrets are included. Raw audit storage is retained in-house for 90 days per our retention policy.

Delivery links (read-only):
- Drive manifest: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KMSEvidence
- S3: s3://redwood-evidence/clearside/2029-04/clearside_kmsevidence_20290409.zip
- JIRA reference for artifact tracking: SEC-4821

If you confirm receipt I'll mark this ticket resolved. If you need any additional extracts (longer retention window, raw operator mapping under NDA, or cryptographic proofs such as HSM attestation statements), say the word and we'll scope next steps.

Thanks — looking forward to closes.

Best,
Priyom Das
Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
